workflow.title: 3 steps to efficient vehicle rental operation
workflow.description: Simple, transparent process — from creating a request to completing a trip.
workflow.step_1_desc: Users create rental requests on the system: choose vehicle type, time, pickup and drop-off points. The order is automatically sent to the Dispatcher.
workflow.step_2_desc: The Dispatcher receives the request, checks available vehicles, allocates a suitable one and assigns a driver. All operations on a single interface.
workflow.step_3_desc: Track trip status in realtime. Upon completion, the system automatically updates operational reports and booking history.

faq.title: Got Questions?
faq.description: Find quick answers to common questions about ThueXe.
faq.q1: Does the system support role-based permissions?
faq.a1: Yes. ThueXe supports clear role-based permissions. Admins have full system access, while Dispatchers focus on receiving and dispatching vehicle rental requests. Each role only accesses appropriate functions.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Dispatcher and Admin?
faq.a2: Dispatchers directly handle rental requests: receive orders, allocate vehicles, assign drivers and track trips. Admins manage the entire system: users, vehicles, drivers, configuration and overall operational reports.
faq.q3: Can I manage multiple vehicles at once?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Depending on your plan, you can manage from 10 to unlimited vehicles. The system displays each vehicle's status (available, in-use, maintenance) and supports smart allocation.
faq.a4: Yes. All rental requests are stored with complete details: time, vehicle type, driver, status and trip results. You can search, filter and export history reports at any time.
faq.q5: Is the system responsive on mobile?
faq.a5: Yes. ThueXe's interface is designed to be responsive, working seamlessly on all devices: desktop, tablet and mobile. Dispatchers can dispatch right from their mobile when needed.
faq.q6: Can it be customized for specific business needs?
faq.a6: With the Enterprise plan, we support custom interfaces, workflows, reports and API integration tailored to your business requirements. Contact our consulting team for details.
